text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I've got a bit of time before training, so maybe I'll brainstorm ideas for next week's stream.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'd rather save that outfit for later in the season, so maybe a new hairstyle...? Or stylish glasses...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Makeup, huh~? That actually sounds pretty fun.
Watching a whole look come together right before your eyes
is just mesmerizing!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let me give this a try♪
First up, the irresistible lovely makeup look!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
First, apply tone-up base evenly...
And then, a radiant foundation over that!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Eyebrows straight-ish... but with a slight arch...
and a soft sweep of classic brown eyeshadow..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Oh gosh, this is so, so cute—♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Loves Only You got so absorbed in researching makeup that she ended up skipping training.
